values: Email / password login: POST to auth.php?action=parent_login. Errors display in-screen alert.
Push token registration: On successful login, registerForPush() obtains an Expo push token and saves it via jobs.php?action=save_push_token (fire-and-forget).
Active job restore: Before routing home, calls get_parent_active_job. If an in-progress job exists, sets global.activeJob and routes to /job-accepted.
Forgot password: Tapping "Forgot password?" sets global.resetUserType="parent" and navigates to /reset-password.
Register link: "Create Parent Account" navigates to /parent-register.
Password toggle: Eye icon toggles password visibility.
Required fields: First name, last name, email, phone, address, city, state, ZIP, password, password confirm.
Validation: All fields required; passwords must match; email format validated; minimum password length enforced.
Account creation: POST to auth.php?action=parent_register. On success, logs user in and routes to parent-home.
Duplicate email: Server returns an error if email already exists; displayed to user.
Live map: Google Maps renders immediately with default Houston coordinates; GPS resolves in background using two-step strategy (last known position first, then precise fix).
Sitter pins: Only real database sitters shown as map pins with photo/initials, first name, and hourly rate. Pins refresh every 10 seconds silently.
Search radius: Parent's search_radius preference (default 10 miles) shown as a pink circle on the map.
Sitter chips: Horizontal scroll list of online sitters below the map showing photo/initials, name, rate, distance, and specialization badges (CPR, Infant, Special Needs, Multilingual).
Specialization filters: Four filter chips (CPR, Infant, Special Needs, Multilingual) filter the sitter chip list. Active filters shown in dark style.
Request Now button: Large gradient button shows count of online sitters. Blocked if no sitters online or active job exists.
Children modal: Before dispatching, parent enters number of children (1–8) and each child's age (0=Infant to 17). This data is sent with the job request.
Payment method gate: If parent has no Stripe card on file, booking is blocked with prompt to add card. Verified via stripe.php?action=get_payment_method.
Dispatch & polling: POST jobs.php?action=request_live; polls job_status every 3 seconds until sitter accepts or all decline/timeout.
Searching animation: Pulsing gradient circle displayed while searching. Cancel button calls cancel_request on server.
Sitter queue display: While waiting, shows up to 3 sitters in the queue with Notified / Next / Queued status tags.
Active job banner: Green top banner appears when hasActiveJob is true. Tapping navigates to /job-accepted. Shows unread chat badge (red) if unread messages > 0.
Chat unread polling: When active job exists, polls get_unread_count every 5 seconds and displays count on banner and drawer button.
Active job drawer state: When job is active the drawer shows "Job In Progress" with Return to Active Job, Schedule, History, and Payment buttons. Cannot request a new sitter.
Schedule button: Opens schedule appointment modal.
Schedule appointment modal: Parent picks date (must be >1 hour future), time, duration (1–8 hrs in presets), number of children + ages, and optional notes. POST to schedule_job.
Upcoming appointments: Scheduled jobs fetched via get_parent_scheduled every 30 seconds. Each card shows date, time, duration, children, city, sitter name (or "Awaiting"), and a Cancel button.
Scheduled job auto-activate: If a scheduled job enters "Sitter arrived" or "In progress" status, app automatically navigates to /job-accepted.
Profile photo: Tapping the avatar in the header opens image picker; photo uploaded to upload_photo; initials shown as fallback.
Settings menu: Gear icon opens action sheet with: Edit Profile, Browse Sitters, My Favorites, Payment Settings, Log Out.
Log out: Clears global.currentUser and global.activeJob; routes to /.
Book Again: When global._bookAgainSitterId is set (from history screen), schedule modal opens automatically with that sitter as preferred.
Sitter info display: Shows sitter name, photo/initials, hourly rate, additional child rate, ETA, and background check badge.
Job status display: Status chip shows current state: Sitter hired / Sitter on way / Sitter arrived / In progress / Complete.
Elapsed timer: Once status reaches "In progress", a live timer counts up in HH:MM:SS.
Estimated charge: Real-time estimated charge shown based on elapsed time and rate (including additional child rate for 2+ children).
Status polling: Polls job_status every 5 seconds; updates UI and timer automatically.
Chat: Chat button navigates to /chat with job_id. Unread badge shown on button.
Unread count polling: Polls get_unread_count every 5 seconds; displays badge.
End Job button: Sends end_job to server; shows final charge summary with duration, rate breakdown, and total. Navigates to parent-home after acknowledgement.
Cancel job: Parent can cancel from this screen; calls cancel_job; navigates home.
Push notification listener: Listens for sitter_arrived, job_started, job_complete push events; auto-updates status display.
Rating prompt: After job completion, parent is prompted to rate the sitter 1–5 stars.
Job list: Fetches completed/cancelled jobs via get_parent_jobs. Shows date, sitter name, duration, amount charged, status badge.
Book Again: Each past job has a "Book Again" button that pre-fills the preferred sitter ID and opens the schedule modal on parent-home.
Rating display: Shows star rating given for each completed job.
Editable fields: First name, last name, email, phone, address, city, state, ZIP, search radius (miles).
Profile photo: Tappable circle opens image picker; uploads via upload_photo; shows current photo or initials fallback.
Children profiles link: Button navigates to /children-profiles.
Save: POST to auth.php?action=update_parent. Updates global.currentUser on success.
View saved card: Calls stripe.php?action=get_payment_method; displays masked card number and brand if card exists.
Add / update card: Opens Stripe card input form; tokenises card and saves via stripe.php?action=save_payment_method.
Remove card: Option to remove saved card.
Payment history: Shows list of past charges with date, amount, and job reference.
Favorites list: Displays sitters the parent has favorited. Tapping a sitter navigates to /sitter-profile-view.
Remove favorite: Swipe or button removes sitter from favorites list via remove_favorite endpoint.
Book from favorites: Each favorite has a direct booking shortcut.
Add child profile: Parent can add children with name and date of birth.
Age auto-calculation: Age displayed based on DOB.
Delete child: Remove a child profile.
Pending/inactive gate: If account status is "pending" or "inactive", routes to /sitter-pending instead of home.
Push token registration: Same pattern as parent login — fire-and-forget save_push_token.
Active job restore: Calls get_sitter_active_job; if in-progress job found, sets global.activeJob and routes to /active-job.
Forgot password / Register: Same pattern as parent login.
Required fields: First name, last name, email, phone, address, city, state, ZIP, date of birth, hourly rate, bio/about text, password.
Specializations: Checkboxes for CPR certified, Infant care, Special Needs experience, Multilingual.
Account creation: POST auth.php?action=sitter_register. New accounts set to "pending" status pending admin approval.
Post-registration: Routes to /sitter-pending after successful registration.
Pending message: Informs sitter their account is under review. No access to home screen.
Log out: Button to log out and return to welcome screen.
Online / Offline toggle: Toggle switch sets sitter availability. POST set_online / set_offline to jobs.php. When offline, no job requests are sent to this sitter.
Location update on go-online: When sitter goes online, current GPS coordinates are sent to update_sitter_location.

Incoming live job modal: Full-screen modal with 60-second countdown timer showing: parent first name, number of children, child ages, distance from sitter (miles), hourly rate. Accept / Decline buttons.
Incoming scheduled job modal: Same layout as live modal but also shows scheduled date/time and duration. Appears 30 minutes before the appointment.
Job acceptance: POST accept_job; routes to /active-job.
Job decline: POST decline_job; dismisses modal. Next sitter in queue is notified by server.
Auto-decline on timeout: If sitter does not respond within 60 seconds, server auto-declines and advances queue; modal dismisses.
Active job banner: Green banner visible when hasActiveJob is true; shows unread chat badge; taps to /active-job.
Chat unread polling: Same 5-second poll pattern as parent-home.
Earnings summary: Shows total lifetime earnings and pending balance fetched from get_sitter_earnings.
Navigation shortcuts: Buttons to: Profile Edit, Availability, Bank Setup, Earnings, Job History.
Push notification listener: Listens for new_job push type; opens incoming job modal when received while app is foregrounded.
Parent info display: Shows parent name, address, number and ages of children.
Job status controls: Sitter can advance status: On My Way → Arrived → Start Job → End Job.
Status POST: Each status change POSTs update_job_status to server; parent receives push notification.
Elapsed timer: Starts when status becomes "In progress"; counts up in real time.
Estimated earnings: Live calculation shown based on elapsed time and rate.
Chat: Chat button navigates to /chat. Unread badge shown.
End Job: Calls end_job; shows earnings summary. Navigates to sitter-home after acknowledgement.
Push listener: Listens for job_cancelled push; if parent cancels, sitter is notified and routed back to sitter-home.
Message list: Fetches messages via get_messages?job_id. Shows sender name, message text, and timestamp. Scrolls to bottom on load.
Send message: Text input + Send button; POST send_message with job_id, sender_type (parent/sitter), message. Appended to list optimistically.
Auto-poll: Polls for new messages every 3 seconds while screen is focused.
Unread mark-read: Calls mark_messages_read on focus; clears unread badge for this viewer.
Push-triggered open: If a chat push notification is tapped, app navigates directly to /chat for that job_id.
Editable fields: First name, last name, email, phone, address, city, state, ZIP, bio/about, hourly rate.
Specialization toggles: CPR, Infant, Special Needs, Multilingual — toggle switches.
Profile photo: Tappable circle opens image picker (1:1 crop, quality 0.7); base64 uploaded via upload_photo. Photo displayed with initials fallback.
Save: POST auth.php?action=update_sitter. Updates global.currentUser on success.
Weekly schedule: Sitter sets available days and time windows for each day of the week.
Save availability: POSTs availability data to save_availability endpoint.
Effect on dispatch: Server respects availability when choosing sitters for scheduled jobs.
Bank details entry: Sitter enters bank name, routing number, and account number.
Account masking: Account number stored and displayed masked (last 4 digits only) after save.
Save: POSTs to save_bank_details; details used when admin processes a payout.
Earnings summary: Total lifetime earnings, total paid out, pending balance.
Transaction history: List of individual job payouts with date, amount, and job reference.
Request payout: Button to request a payout for the pending balance; creates a payout_request record for admin review.
Payout status: Shows status of pending payout requests (pending / approved / paid / rejected).
Browse all sitters: Paginated list of all active sitters. Filter by specialization, rating, distance.
Search by name: Text search filters list by sitter name.
View profile: Tapping a sitter navigates to /sitter-profile-view.
Favorite: Heart icon on each card adds/removes sitter from parent's favorites.
Profile display: Shows sitter photo, name, rating, rate, distance, bio, specialization badges, background check status.
Request Now: Triggers booking flow on parent-home for this specific sitter.
Schedule with sitter: Opens schedule modal pre-filled with this sitter as preferred.
Favorite toggle: Add/remove from parent favorites.
Reviews: Shows past parent ratings and comments.
Referral code display: Parent's unique referral code shown on /referral screen.
Share: Native share sheet opens with pre-written message containing the referral code.
Copy code: Copy to clipboard button (expo-clipboard).
Reward tracking: Shows how many referrals used and credits earned ($5 per referred signup who books).
Request reset: Email entered on /reset-password; POST auth.php?action=request_reset sends OTP/link to email.
User type routing: global.resetUserType (parent/sitter) set before navigation ensures correct account type is targeted.
Set new password: OTP/token verified; new password entered and confirmed; POST auth.php?action=reset_password.
Sitter discovery: jobs.php?action=nearby_sitters returns sitters within parent's radius ordered by Haversine distance (calculated in PHP, never SQL).
request_live: Creates a job record in "Open" status; builds a dispatch queue of nearby online available sitters ordered nearest-first; notifies first sitter via push.
Queue advancement: If sitter declines or 60 seconds elapse, server auto-advances to next sitter in queue.
Job statuses: "Open" → "Sitter hired" → "Sitter offered" → "Sitter arrived" → "In progress" → "Complete" / "Cancelled".
Distance stored: Haversine distance at dispatch time stored in job_routing.distance_mi and included in sitter's incoming job modal.
All declined: If all sitters in queue decline/timeout, job status set to "Closed"; parent alerted.
cancel_request: Parent cancelling during search closes the job and dismisses the sitter's modal if currently shown.
schedule_job: Creates job with scheduled_time, duration_hours, and optional preferred_sitter_id.
30-minute notification: Server dispatches push to available sitters 30 minutes before scheduled_time.
Preferred sitter: If preferred_sitter_id set, that sitter is placed first in the queue.
Parent polling: parent-home polls get_parent_scheduled every 30 seconds to update upcoming list and detect when a scheduled job goes live.
Cancel scheduled: cancel_scheduled removes the job; parent list updates immediately.
Rate calculation: charge_amt = (elapsed_hours × minrate) + max(0, kids-1) × additional_child_rate.
Auto-charge on end: end_job triggers Stripe charge to parent's saved card via stripe.php.
Sitter payout: Net earnings (after platform fee) credited to sitter's earnings balance.
Payout request: Sitter requests payout via sitter-earnings screen; admin approves and marks paid via admin portal.
Push on payout update: Sitter receives push notification when payout status changes to approved, paid, or rejected.
new_job: Sent to sitter when a job is dispatched to them. Opens incoming job modal.
job_accepted: Sent to parent when a sitter accepts. Triggers route to /job-accepted.
sitter_arrived: Sent to parent when sitter taps "Arrived". Updates status display.
job_started: Sent to parent when sitter taps "Start Job". Starts elapsed timer.
job_complete: Sent to parent when job ends. Shows charge summary.
job_cancelled: Sent to sitter if parent cancels during active job.
new_chat_message: Sent to the other party on each chat message. Tapping routes to /chat.
payout_update: Sent to sitter when admin changes payout request status.
Token storage: Expo push tokens stored per user type in the database; updated on each login.
Expo Go exclusion: Push token registration skipped in Expo Go (Constants.appOwnership === "expo").
Stats cards: Shows total parents, total sitters, jobs today, jobs this month, open jobs now, total revenue this month.
Auto-refresh: Stats refresh every 60 seconds automatically.
Recent jobs table: Lists most recent 20 jobs with ID, parent, sitter, status, amount, and date.
Sitter list: Paginated table with name, email, Checkr background check status, online/offline indicator, rating, completed job count, and account status.
Search: Text search filters sitters by name or email.
Edit sitter: Modal to set: Checkr status (pending/clear/consider/suspended), is_active (active/suspended), admin notes.
Save changes: POST jobs.php?action=admin_update_sitter; updates database record.
Activate / Suspend: Setting is_active to "suspended" blocks sitter from going online or receiving jobs.
Parent list: Paginated table with name, email, job count, cancellation count (warning flag if ≥3), and status.
Edit parent: Modal to set: is_active, cancel_count, admin notes.
Suspend parent: Setting is_active to "suspended" blocks parent from making new bookings.
Payout list: Paginated table showing ID, sitter name, amount, bank name, masked account number (last 4 digits), request date, and current status.
Status filter: Dropdown filters list by status: pending / approved / paid / rejected.
Process payout: "Process" button opens modal with full bank details, status selector (approved/paid/rejected), and admin notes field.
Save payout status: POST admin_update_payout; sets paid_at timestamp when status set to "paid"; sends push notification to sitter.
Completed payouts: Paid and rejected payouts show "Done" instead of a Process button.
Admin portal auth: Session-based password authentication on admin.php. All admin API actions require valid session.
Parent API isolation: Parent endpoints validate parent_id against authenticated session to prevent cross-user data access.
Sitter API isolation: Sitter endpoints validate sitter_id. Sitter ID always resolved as user.id || user.u_id.
Stripe PCI: Card numbers never touch the app server — tokenised via Stripe SDK before any server call.
Account masking: Bank account numbers stored and displayed as last-4-digits only.
Background check: Checkr background check status controlled exclusively by admin; sitters cannot self-verify.
Account approval: Sitter accounts start as "pending"; only admin can activate to allow login to home screen.
